integrity: Standalone exact-search source code and independent mathematical derivations are provided. Search covers every code of cardinality at most eight. Public contents contain only science and reproducibility; no independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The finite classification and optimum exchange geometry concern only the Nauru graph GP(12,5), for ordinary locating domination; the general cubic bound is prior art. The exhaustive finite programs do not generalize to an arbitrary Petersen family. Literature priority is provisional pending independent review.
title: Eighteen Nauru locating codes and a sharp five-sensor exchange threshold
